purpose: diagnostic Hough proposal comparison only; not the production detector or acceptance evidence

method.candidateGenerator: OpenCV HOUGH_GRADIENT on a cloth mask approximating VisionAnalyzer.ClothMask
method.rawRadiusModel: global min/max envelope from calibration inverse-homography Jacobian sampled over the table, with 15% margin
method.rawPocketMask: rectified circular pocket masks projected into raw perspective as local ellipses
method.matching: greedy one-to-one geometry-only centre match within the configured rectified-pixel radius
limitations: This comparator runs only a Hough proposal stage; it does not recreate the production colour-body, packed-cluster, dark-body, classifier, boundary-refiner or uncertainty stages.
Raw Hough uses one global radius envelope and median-scaled separation; it does not model a position-varying ellipse per proposal.
Labels are provisional visual estimates, and frame 1365 has no defensible black centre.
Threshold sweeps include the labelled frames and are diagnostic; do not interpret the best threshold as held-out performance.
A gain here would justify a native or better-calibrated proposal A/B, not a production detector change.
